mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing a wonderful 74 degrees with clear skies around Badger Ridge Middle School, feeling closer to 79. Tonight features a waxing crescent moon, and you can catch a great view of the International Space Station passing overhead at 9:31 PM for about six minutes.

In city news, Verona is continuing its push for sustainability and resource management. Apartment residents can drop off food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue, while homeowners can save money with the city's toilet rebate program or request contour maps to build flood-mitigating rain gardens.

We have a busy lineup of events starting July 19th, including the Mount Horeb Art Fair, live music at Lake Louie and Bailey's Run, and Hop Haus Trivia. Plus, mark your calendars for July 22nd to enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.

From the police department's weekly report, last Thursday, July 9th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at County Highway PB and American Way where a 16-year-old driver was cited for failing to yield, resulting in minor injuries to a 74-year-old woman.

Wrap up your day with a sweet treat. Culver's is serving up their rich Turtle flavor today. They are open for another 11 hours, closing at 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to get your custard fix. Tomorrow's flavor will be Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
